title: Two Class 10 Girls Critical After Chainsaw Attack Inside Andhra School
excerpt: A man attacked two students inside a classroom at a government school in Raptadu, Anantapur district, on October 31; police are investigating and officials have not confirmed a motive.
body:
• Two Class 10 students were seriously injured in a chainsaw attack inside Zilla Parishad High School at Raptadu, in Andhra Pradesh's Anantapur district, on Saturday, October 31, officials said.
  • One student sustained severe injuries to her face, head, throat, neck and abdomen, with her right hand reportedly almost severed; a classmate who intervened to protect her was also seriously injured, according to officials cited by IANS and Nation Press.
  • Both students were taken to hospital for emergency critical care, and their condition was described as critical in the reports read for this article.
  • Police launched an investigation; officials cited in the earliest reports had not established a motive or confirmed whether the attacker knew the student, and later reports differed on whether a man had been arrested - readers should treat arrest and motive claims as developing until police confirm them.

Two Class 10 students were seriously injured after a man attacked them with a chainsaw inside their classroom at Zilla Parishad High School in Raptadu, Anantapur district, Andhra Pradesh, on Saturday, October 31, officials said. One student sustained deep wounds to her face, head, throat, neck and abdomen, and her right hand was reportedly almost severed. A second student who attempted to intervene and protect her classmate was also seriously injured. Both were taken to hospital for emergency critical care, according to IANS and Nation Press.

What officials have said happened

According to officials cited by Nation Press, the man entered the school premises at Raptadu and reached a classroom without being intercepted. The attack caused panic among students and staff. After the man fled, teachers alerted police and called for an ambulance, and the two injured students were transferred for emergency treatment. IANS reported that family members and parents raised questions about how a man carrying a chainsaw could enter the premises and reach a classroom without being stopped.

"I am deeply shaken and enraged by the barbaric attack on a Class 10 student inside her classroom at Raptadu ZP High School."

- N. Chandrababu Naidu, Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister, on X

Official response

Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu said on X that he was personally tracking the injured student's recovery and had directed the medical team to give her the highest priority care, Northeast Herald reported. State minister Nara Lokesh also expressed shock on X and said the chief minister had directed police to take swift and stringent action, the report added. This article repeats only the statements carried in the reports cited above; it does not reproduce graphic detail beyond what officials described.

Investigation and what is not yet confirmed

Police in Anantapur launched an extensive investigation, IANS reported. In those earliest reports, investigators had not determined whether the man was known to the student before the attack, and no motive had been established. Later coverage differed on the man's status: Northeast Herald's report stated the accused had been arrested, while the IANS and Nation Press reports described a manhunt under way. Because those accounts conflict and no police statement confirming an arrest, an identity or a motive was among the sources read for this article, The Videshi is not naming a suspect or stating a motive. Parents at the school have asked how security allowed a man with a chainsaw to reach a classroom; officials cited in the reports had not yet provided that explanation.

What happens next

The immediate questions are medical and investigative: updates on the two students' condition from the treating hospital, and a confirmed police account of how the man entered the school, whether he has been arrested, and what investigators have established. No verified fundraiser or official help channel for the families was carried in the sources read for this article, so none is linked here. This is a developing story and will be updated when police or hospital officials confirm further facts.
nri_angle: Reports a serious school-safety incident in Andhra Pradesh factually for diaspora readers with family in the state, without unverified suspect or motive claims.
